rationale: PCA is highest (5) because consumer-grade voice cloning APIs (ElevenLabs, OpenAI Voice) produce deployable audio for cents per minute, replacing hours of voice-actor labor. DDI is high (4) because audio deepfake detectors exist but degrade severely under codec compression, phone-channel transmission, and adversarial perturbation. AAS is mid (3) because podcast/audio platforms are largely format-neutral without the engagement-bait amplification dynamics of short-form video.
